entry_triggers.name: trg_immutable_posted_entries
entry_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_immutable_posted_entries BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.journal_entries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION finance_prevent_posted_entry_mutation()

entry_triggers.name: trg_closed_period_guard
entry_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_closed_period_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.journal_entries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION finance_guard_closed_period()

entry_triggers.name: trg_balanced_on_post
entry_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_balanced_on_post BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.journal_entries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION finance_validate_journal_posting()

line_triggers.name: trg_immutable_posted_lines
line_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_immutable_posted_lines BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.journal_lines FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION finance_prevent_posted_line_mutation()

line_triggers.name: trg_line_entity_consistency
line_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_line_entity_consistency BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.journal_lines FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION finance_guard_line_account_entity()

implication: Allowed draft UPDATE returns OLD and can suppress status/posted_at changes in production. This catalogue query does not establish historical affected-row counts or financial balances.
counts_interpretation: Aggregate persisted state only. Draft existence does not identify which rows should be posted or attribute any row to the defective trigger. No row identifiers, descriptions, source refs, monetary totals or customer data selected.
